description: A client-side HTML file implementing a web-based database visualizer interface with embedded CSS styles and JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and UI interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, reinitializing the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands/collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell with special handling for large objects and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or object data.
